Together they sound three-dimensional, in a way that a single overdrive pedal into a single amp almost never does.
He called it the Pork Loin Soft Clip Injection Overdrive , gave it a model number of WHE201 , painted it purple, and — with a straight face — printed the phrase “the masses of pork power that exude from its space age circuitry” in the official product copy.
Underneath it is one of the most quietly intelligent overdrive designs of the modern era, and one of the very few that is genuinely useful to guitarists and bassists.

It is not a distortion sound. It is the sound of two amplifiers running at once — one glassy and clean, one cooking — with a Y-cable or an A/B/Y box splitting the guitar between them. Stevie Ray Vaughan built a career on it. So did half of Muscle Shoals. The clean amp keeps the pick attack, the string separation and the top-end sparkle; the dirty amp supplies the weight and the sustain underneath. Neither amp on its own sounds like the record. Together they sound three-dimensional, in a way that a single overdrive pedal into a single amp almost never does. GG-ARTICLE-AFTER-INTRO The problem is obvious: two amps means two amps. Two of everything to carry, two of everything to mic, two of everything to break down at the load-out. Which is why, in late 2008, when Jeorge Tripps was handed the keys to a resurrected Way Huge Electronics by Jim Dunlop, one of the very first things he built was a pedal that does the whole trick internally. He called it the Pork Loin Soft Clip Injection Overdrive , gave it a model number of WHE201 , painted it purple, and — with a straight face — printed the phrase “the masses of pork power that exude from its space age circuitry” in the official product copy. The joke name has cost this pedal a lot of respect over the years. Underneath it is one of the most quietly intelligent overdrive designs of the modern era, and one of the very few that is genuinely useful to guitarists and bassists. It is also, as of now, out of production — which changes the whole conversation about whether you should buy one. We will get to that.
